name: Pre-movement, good alarm
applies_when: Residential, alarm audible in the flat
finding: Residential cluster 1, Weibull scale 102.475 s shape 0.767, 149 data points. Implied mean 120 s, median 64 s.
notes: Strongly right-skewed: shape below 1 means more skewed than exponential. A few residents take very much longer than the median, which is the part a mean hides.

name: Pre-movement, poor alarm or real fire
finding: Residential cluster 2, Weibull scale 724.617 s shape 0.978, 78 data points. Implied mean 732 s. Proulx and Fahy measured 515 s for poor-alarm drills.
notes: Six times the good-alarm mean. Audibility is the single largest lever in the whole model.

name: Walking speed, working-age adult
finding: Comfortable adult walking speed about 1.20 m/s with a standard deviation near 0.24 m/s.
notes: The spread matters as much as the mean: a household moves at its slowest member's pace.

name: Walking speed, 65 and over
finding: Older adults are markedly slower on the level and on stairs.
notes: Mean reasoned from the sourced elderly range rather than read off a table.

name: Walking speed, under 18
finding: Children are slower than adults; small children occupied the full stair width.

name: Patience behind a blockage
finding: No measurement found. Queue tolerance measured in lift queues runs one to five minutes, which suggests this range is too impatient.
notes: Carried because an engine we use has it. A sensitivity run should settle whether it matters.

name: Visibility at which people turn back
finding: Share of occupants who turn back at or below each visibility.
notes: Stated as published: the share who turn back at or below a visibility, so a higher quantile means a more tolerant resident. Relabelled from SOURCED on 2026-10-27 - the curve was carried across from an engine's sourced rule set without the study behind it being recorded here. The shape is very likely from the smoke-visibility work already cited elsewhere on this Sheet (Jin 1978, Frantzich and Nilsson 2003, or Fridolf et al. 2013); establishing which is a small job, and it would move several chains from ESTIMATE back to SOURCED.

name: Tries the other staircase after turning back
finding: Of those who turn back, about a quarter try the other staircase rather than going home.
notes: The share is carried from an engine's sourced set; the citation behind it still needs recording here.
